documents.title: Pension assistance: intake and eligibility
documents.body: The demo pension service helps a citizen start a social-welfare intake request. Use Check eligibility to enter age, annual household income and state. The illustrative rules check age 60 or above, annual income at or below INR 32,000, and residence in Karnataka. These are not official pension criteria. The example document list is proof of age, an income certificate, proof of residence and bank account details. Do not upload identity or bank documents into this demo. The responsible department is Social Welfare. Official fees, scheme benefits and current government rules are not loaded.

documents.title: Birth certificate: start and track a request
documents.body: The demo birth-certificate service belongs to Civil Registration. Open New application, select Birth certificate and a district, then review and create the intake request. The request is local demo state, not a submission to a registrar or government portal. Your applications shows its stage, officer and service deadline. No verified official birth-certificate document checklist, fee schedule, correction rules or issuance/download integration is loaded. Refer to the responsible department for those official requirements; the assistant must not invent them.

documents.title: Property registration: house and land requests
documents.body: Property registration is a Revenue department demo service for house or land-related intake. Start a New application with Property registration and the desired district. Case details show the verification stage and any delay against the demo service deadline. A pending verification stage indicates work awaiting verification, not proof of misconduct. Official stamp duty, tax rates, ownership validation, property documents, appointments and registration fees are not connected. This application cannot legally register property or generate a deed.

documents.title: Driving license renewal: transport service
documents.body: The demo driving-license renewal service belongs to Transport. Choose Driving license renewal in New application and select a district. Review and submit only when ready; this creates a local intake request. No transport authority submission, driving test, medical check, real license download, fee schedule or official renewal checklist is integrated. Track your own application ID under Your applications. For legally valid renewal requirements, use the responsible transport authority's official guidance.

documents.title: Water supply: report service concerns
documents.body: Water supply is a Public Works demo service. For a broken pipe, outage, leak or poor supply, open Raise a grievance, choose Water supply and the district, describe the problem without private identifiers, review and submit. The app records demo feedback; it does not dispatch a repair team, contact a utility or resolve an emergency. A new service intake can also be created with New application. For urgent real-world incidents, contact the responsible local authority through its official channel.

documents.title: Tracking, deadlines and escalation consent
documents.body: Your applications shows only cases owned by the signed-in citizen. Give a specific application ID to avoid mixing up multiple cases. An unresolved application is overdue only after its service-specific deadline; exactly at the deadline is not yet a breach. Resolved cases freeze elapsed time at the resolution date. Escalation requires an explicit application action or consent in Citizen chat. Samanvay's assistant endpoint cannot escalate, create or submit anything. A successful escalation updates the case and one unique audit event together. No external email, SMS or officer notification is delivered.

documents.title: Demo limits, voice privacy and government sources
documents.body: All seeded citizens, cases and policies are synthetic or illustrative. No authoritative government policy corpus or departmental API is connected. Gemini, when configured, phrases supplied evidence rather than verifying it against government sources. Browser speech recognition may send audio to the browser provider. This app receives text and does not store microphone audio. Do not send Aadhaar numbers, bank details, addresses or other sensitive personal information. Personalized memory is opt-in and should contain only approved preferences and bounded service context, not identity documents or inferred eligibility.
